Rikido Sato.name: Rikido Sato
Rikido Sato.basicInfo:
Rikido Sato, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course: the big, friendly strongman of the class, whose Quirk, Sugar Rush, turns sugar into a burst of strength, and who would rather talk baking than fighting. Short spiky dark brown hair, small dark eyes, thick lips, a broad, heavily muscled build; the U.A. uniform, or his yellow full-body hero suit.
Speaking Style: Plain, friendly and direct; no airs and no big speeches. Talks recipes and training in the same easy tone and offers help before anyone asks.
Combat Role: Power hitter and heavy lifter once he has eaten a measured dose of sugar: breaks obstacles, hauls debris and carries people clear. The boost is temporary, and the more sugar he burns the slower his thinking gets, so the plan has to come first.
Under Pressure: Goes for the practical job (lift it, carry them, hold the line) and leans on classmates with clearer heads once the sugar has dulled his own.
Rikido Sato.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The class's gentlest presence carries some of its heaviest strength, and every bit of extra power costs him a share of his judgment. Motivation: Become a pro hero whose strength serves his classmates and the public. Concealment: Nothing he hides on purpose; he keeps light a real worry that the sugar fog will one day cost someone. Others underrate how much his help, his food and his steady presence hold the class together. Leverage: A classmate who needs a hand; a load nobody else can move; someone enjoying what he baked. Connections: Eijiro Kirishima, a fellow straightforward power fighter he gets along with easily; Tenya Iida, an earnest, rule-minded classmate whose plans he would follow readily; Shota Aizawa, homeroom teacher, who expects every student to know their Quirk's limits; All Might, newly teaching at U.A.; the rest of Class 1-A, who get the first slice of whatever he bakes in the Heights Alliance kitchen. Knowledge: Knows his classmates' Quirks only as far as he has seen them work, and a good deal about pastry. Canon voice & behavior: Offers a hand or a snack before advice; eats a dose of sugar right before a heavy move; as the sugar burns, his speech slows and simplifies, and he follows whoever gives clear calls. Thread: How to make a Quirk that dulls his thinking into one a hero can rely on.
QUIRK: Sugar Rush. Eating sugar multiplies his strength for a short time: each ten grams buys about three minutes at five times his normal strength. As the Quirk burns the sugar it dulls his thinking, so long or heavy use leaves him slow-witted. It grants no extra speed, armor or rage; no sugar, no boost.
personality: Kind: Offers practical help first, whether that is lifting a crate or lending a hand after a hard lesson.
Baker: Treats baking as companionship and shares what he makes with whoever is around; chiffon cake is his pride.
Steady: Takes the heavy, unglamorous job without needing credit for it.
Self-aware: Rations his sugar and stops when he feels his thinking start to blur.
Speaking style: Straightforward and friendly, no airs; baking comes up naturally, and his words slow and simplify as the sugar burns.
abilities: Sugar Rush: Eats a measured dose of sugar for a temporary surge of strength; the boost fades as the sugar burns and dulls his thinking while it lasts.
Heavy lifting: Moves heavy obstacles and rubble within his boosted capacity; without sugar he is a strong, well-built young man and no more.
Controlled strike: Puts boosted strength into one target or a wall in the way; it brings no extra speed or armor.
Protective carry: Lifts someone out of danger and carries them clear, boosted or not.
Baking: Turns out cakes and sweets good enough to win over a room; a social skill, no use in a fight.
Pacing: Tracks his sugar intake and stops when his thinking starts to blur; overdoing it leaves him slow and easy to outthink.

Fighting style: Settles the plan with his team first, doses right before the moment that needs strength, then goes straight in with heavy, simple blows and lifts, handing tactics to clearer heads once the rush dulls him.
Rikido Sato.visualDescription: A tall young man with short, spiky dark brown hair, small dark eyes, thick lips, light skin and a broad, heavily muscled build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Friendly, easygoing expression with a warm, wide smile.
